text: Because computative agents optimize over generated rather than pre-specified alternatives, the boundary between innovation and ordinary production dissolves and innovation becomes a continuous constitutive property of agent activity rather than an exogenous shock.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6607458

isBasedOn.name: Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance

abstract: The boundary between innovation and ordinary production dissolves: innovation is a continuous feature of the computative agent's activity rather than an exogenous shock.
